sentences.text: Leonard Norman Cohen -LRB- September 21 , 1934 -- November 7 , 2016 -RRB- was a Canadian singer , songwriter , musician , poet , novelist , and painter .
His work explored religion , politics , isolation , sexuality , and personal relationships .

Cohen was inducted into the Canadian Music Hall of Fame , the Canadian Songwriters Hall of Fame , and the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame .	Canadian Music Hall of Fame	Canadian Music Hall of Fame	Canadian Songwriters Hall of Fame	Canadian Songwriters Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame	Rock and Roll Hall of Fame
He was a Companion of the Order of Canada , the nation 's highest civilian honor .	Order of Canada	Order of Canada

In 2011 , Cohen received one of the Prince of Asturias Awards for literature and the ninth Glenn Gould Prize .	Prince of Asturias Awards	Princess of Asturias Awards	Glenn Gould Prize	Glenn Gould Prize
Cohen pursued a career as a poet and novelist during the 1950s and early 1960s ; he did not launch a music career until 1967 , at the age of 33 .

His first album , Songs of Leonard Cohen -LRB- 1967 -RRB- , was followed by three more albums of folk music : Songs from a Room -LRB- 1969 -RRB- , Songs of Love and Hate -LRB- 1971 -RRB- and New Skin for the Old Ceremony -LRB- 1974 -RRB- .	Songs of Leonard Cohen	Songs of Leonard Cohen	folk music	Contemporary folk music	Songs from a Room	Songs from a Room	Songs of Love and Hate	Songs of Love and Hate	New Skin for the Old Ceremony	New Skin for the Old Ceremony
His 1977 record Death of a Ladies ' Man was co-written and produced by Phil Spector , which was a move away from Cohen 's previous minimalist sound .	Phil Spector	Phil Spector
In 1979 , Cohen returned with the more traditional Recent Songs , which blended his acoustic style with jazz and Oriental and Mediterranean influences .	Recent Songs	Recent Songs
Perhaps Cohen 's most famous song , `` Hallelujah '' was first released on his studio album Various Positions in 1984 .	Hallelujah	Hallelujah (Leonard Cohen song)	Various Positions	Various Positions
I 'm Your Man in 1988 marked Cohen 's turn to synthesized productions and remains his most popular album .
In 1992 , Cohen released its follow-up , The Future , which had dark lyrics and references to political and social unrest .	The Future	The Future (Leonard Cohen album)
Cohen returned to music in 2001 with the release of Ten New Songs , which was a major hit in Canada and Europe .	Ten New Songs	Ten New Songs
His eleventh album , Dear Heather , followed in 2004 .	Dear Heather	Dear Heather

After a successful string of tours between 2008 and 2010 , Cohen released three albums in the final four years of his life : Old Ideas -LRB- 2012 -RRB- , Popular Problems -LRB- 2014 -RRB- and You Want It Darker -LRB- 2016 -RRB- , the last of which was released three weeks before his death .
